LitRadar third-party source and license notices

The following unmodified upstream Rust crates are used by the HTML parser and
are distributed under the Mozilla Public License 2.0 (MPL-2.0). Their complete
Source Code Form, including upstream copyright and license notices, is available
from the exact versioned source archives below. The source remains governed by
MPL-2.0; the accompanying MPL-2.0.txt contains that license.

cssparser 0.37.0
https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/cssparser/0.37.0/download

cssparser-macros 0.7.1
https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/cssparser-macros/0.7.1/download

dtoa-short 0.3.5
https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/dtoa-short/0.3.5/download

selectors 0.38.0
https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/selectors/0.38.0/download

Exact package checksums are recorded in Cargo.lock. The signed release SPDX SBOM
records the complete image dependency inventory; this notice covers the pinned
MPL-2.0 parser dependency exceptions in deny.toml.

Obscura 0.2.2+litradar.1
Copyright the Obscura contributors. Licensed under Apache-2.0; see
Obscura-LICENSE.txt. The image builds the native DOM/JavaScript fetch command with
stealth transport from this exact upstream source:
https://github.com/h4ckf0r0day/obscura/tree/a1e09de68c7617b8079fbb1661b0548c501971c1
https://codeload.github.com/h4ckf0r0day/obscura/tar.gz/a1e09de68c7617b8079fbb1661b0548c501971c1

LitRadar modifies only Cargo.lock through the accompanying obscura-rustls.patch:
rustls 0.23.45 and rustls-webpki 0.103.15 fix GHSA-2mjx-qc3c-rqvc. The build enables
rendering and stealth and preserves upstream panic unwinding. Dockerfile
records source and V8 archive checksums. Obscura-dependencies.txt in the image
records the compiled normal dependency graph; obscura-dependencies/ preserves
the downloaded Rust crates' license, notice and copying files, together with
the embedded DejaVu, Liberation and Noto Color Emoji font notices. Complete crate
sources are available at https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/NAME/VERSION/download,
substituting the exact names and versions from that dependency graph.
Vendored path dependencies are included in the pinned Obscura source archive;
their license notices are preserved under obscura-dependencies/vendor/.

Poppler's pdftotext and its libraries are installed from Debian packages. Their
copyright and license notices remain under /usr/share/doc in the image.

SQLite simple tokenizer
-----------------------
Source: https://github.com/wangfenjin/simple/tree/45db071ba8043ffe8a2e5dfe41f9d68fb477576c
Source archive SHA256: d60f39ecad1f4fcf46485810708353777224ddc3829b7c9de865034277481e61
License: MIT (selected from the upstream MIT OR GPL-3.0-or-later options).
Copyright and permission text: Simple-LICENSE.txt.
Linux builds disable Jieba. LitRadar uses simple 0, with no pinyin aliases or query expansion.
